'''Rei Yamazaki''' (Japanese: '''山崎玲愛''' ''Yamazaki Rei'') is an animator, illustrator, and character designer who has worked on the Pokémon series. She is one of the chief animation directors and the lead character designer for {{aniseries|HZ}}.

Yamazaki began working on the Pokémon series as a key animator for {{aniseries|XY}}. She made her animation directorial debut on ''[[SM069|Rise and Shine, Starship!]]'' during {{aniseries|SM}}. In addition to her work on the main [[Pokémon animated series]], she also directed the first episode of ''[[Pokémon Evolutions]]'', ''[[PE01|The Champion]]''.

She is credited as '''Yamazaki Rei''' as an illustrator for the {{pkmn|Trading Card Game}}. She illustrates exclusively for cards related to the animated series. Her first cards were the {{TCG|SVP Black Star Promos}} {{TCG ID|SVP Promo|Sprigatito|191}} and {{TCG ID|SVP|Terapagos & Friends|Promo}}.
